rdfs:label: date
rdfs:comment: A point or period of time associated with the resource — generic when more specific date predicates don't apply.
notes: Generic date property — prefer the more specific `urn:solid:created`, `urn:solid:modified`, `urn:solid:issued`, `urn:solid:available` when the role of the date is known. Super-property of created, modified, issued, available, dateAccepted, dateSubmitted and dateCopyrighted. Useful for legacy data or when the date's role is unclear. ISO 8601 values (date, dateTime or interval).

history.note: Dropped xsd:dateTime range (value may be a period); replaced schema:dateCreated in seeAlso with issued/available; listed sub-properties in notes.
